violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Sponge-like shelving liners used in facility. Not durable for commercial use.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Cooking equipment in kitchen has build up of grease and needs cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Storage shelving/cabinets have build up of food debris and need cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Hood system is in need of cleaning.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical ware-washing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. Service dish machine.--Ware-wash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. Service dish machine as needed. Ensure all chemical lines are free of blockages and chemical supply buckets are full.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Sponge-like shelving liner not proper design for food service.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Fryer area needs cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Detail cleaning needed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor needs cleaning in walk in cooler and around fryer.
